info.name: Datadog Get All Workload Protection Policies

items.docs:
Get the list of Workload Protection policies.

**Note**: This endpoint is not available for the Government (US1-FED) site. Please reference the (US1-FED) specific resource below.

info.name: Datadog Create a Workload Protection Policy

items.docs:
Create a new Workload Protection policy with the given parameters.

**Note**: This endpoint is not available for the Government (US1-FED) site. Please reference the (US1-FED) specific resource below.

info.name: Datadog Download the Workload Protection Policy

items.docs:
The download endpoint generates a Workload Protection policy file from your currently active
Workload Protection agent rules, and downloads them as a `.policy` file. This file can then be deployed to
your agents to update the policy running in your environment.

**Note**: This endpoint is not available for the Government (US1-FED) site. Please reference the (US1-FED) specific resource below.

items.docs: Retrieves the restriction policy associated with a specified resource.

info.name: Datadog Update a Restriction Policy

params.name: allow_self_lockout
params.description: Allows admins (users with the `user_access_manage` permission) to remove their own access from the resource if set to `true`. By default, this is set to `false`, preventing admins from locking themselves out.

items.docs:
Updates the restriction policy associated with a resource.

#### Supported resources
Restriction policies can be applied to the following resources:
- Dashboards: `dashboard`
- Integration Accounts: `integration-account`
- Integration Services: `integration-service`
- Integration Webhooks: `integration-webhook`
- Notebooks: `notebook`
- Powerpacks: `powerpack`
- Reference Tables: `reference-table`
- Security Rules: `security-rule`
- Service Level Objectives: `slo`
- Synthetic Global Variables: `
